system:
You are the editor deciding posting order for promo clips from one show.
You will see each promo's hook, cliffhanger and a blind viewer's comprehension result.

Reply with JSON only, and keep it short:
{
  "order": ["<promo_id>", "<promo_id>", ...],
  "post_first": "<promo_id>",
  "post_first_reason": "<two sentences maximum>",
  "rationale": {"<promo_id>": "<one short clause>"}
}

Include every promo_id you were given in "order". Put a rationale for the top 5
only. Favour promos a stranger understood, that open on something physical or
shocking, and that leave a question. Spread hook types rather than posting four
of a kind.

  hook: Juliana erupts, shouting “You planted it!”
  cliffhanger: Clarissa orders Juliana to retrieve the emerald signet ring with her bare hands before the magistrate arrives, leaving the task’s outcome unknown

p_028_a | episodes [28] | 23s | hook_type power reversal | code score 0.94 | blind viewer 4/4
  hook: Juliana erupts, demanding no one speak of her husband, instantly thrusting the viewer into a fierce power struggle.
  cliffhanger: Catherine threatens that Juliana will be sent to the gallows, leaving her fate hanging.

p_046_a | episodes [46] | 36s | hook_type power reversal | code score 0.93 | blind viewer 4/4
  hook: A High Priest declares he can erase three years of stolen love in a single hearing.
  cliffhanger: Alexander threatens to bring the Crown down on the priest, leaving the verdict unknown.

p_047_a | episodes [47] | 30s | hook_type power reversal | code score 0.91 | blind viewer 4/4
  hook: Catherine’s desperate scream for mercy grabs attention instantly.
  cliffhanger: Juliana’s cold command that Catherine must scrub the floors leaves her fate hanging.

p_032_a | episodes [32] | 29s | hook_type power reversal | code score 0.91 | blind viewer 4/4
  hook: Catherine’s frantic scream “Why?!” erupts as she confronts Juliana with a branding rod.
  cliffhanger: She threatens to brand Juliana, leaving the audience hanging on whether the rod will actually touch her skin.

p_004_a | episodes [4] | 22s | hook_type power reversal | code score 0.90 | blind viewer 3/4
  hook: The priest’s booming declaration “...husband and wife!” instantly reveals a shocking marriage.
  cliffhanger: Lady Ashcroft’s venomous “You are disowned!” leaves the fate of the couple hanging.

p_033_a | episodes [33] | 22s | hook_type moral outrage | code score 0.90 | blind viewer 4/4
  hook: Lord threatens that the county gaol will take her brother before sunrise, raising the stakes instantly.
  cliffhanger: Maid begs, "What do you want me to say?!" leaving the lord's demand unresolved.

p_042_a | episodes [42] | 23s | hook_type moral outrage | code score 0.88 | blind viewer 4/4
  hook: A furious nobleman shouts, “Guards! Arrest this imposter!”
  cliffhanger: Alexander declares he’s alive, exposing the lie the nobleman built his life on.

p_001_a | episodes [1] | 24s | hook_type moral outrage | code score 0.88 | blind viewer 3/4
  hook: Juliana erupts, accusing someone of knowing a terrible secret before she even entered the room.
  cliffhanger: She demands, “And you knew?” leaving the truth hanging.

p_044_a | episodes [44] | 48s | hook_type power reversal | code score 0.88 | blind viewer 4/4
  hook: A royal guard slams Rupert to the ground, blood and dust flying.
  cliffhanger: Catherine defiantly declares she loved Alexander before everything fell apart, leaving his cold stare unanswered.

p_048_a | episodes [48] | 39s | hook_type power reversal | code score 0.87 | blind viewer 4/4
  hook: Catherine reveals she was humiliated in the chapel, sparking a vengeful plan.
  cliffhanger: She orders that no one sees the priest arrive, leaving his fate unknown.

p_024_a | episodes [24] | 22s | hook_type power reversal | code score 0.86 | blind viewer 4/4
  hook: The noblewoman whips around and thrusts her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
  cliffhanger: Juliana declares she will return, vowing the healer cannot be stopped.
